data.source_title: Waiting for Triage: Unmeasured Time in Patient Flow
data.locator: Methods and Results; arrival-to-triage results for patients requiring greeting before triage
data.source_setting: Urban academic tertiary ED, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, Massachusetts, United States; approximately 54,000 annual visits.
data.source_n: 50,576 total visits; 7,795 (15.4%) did not go directly to bed or triage and were included in the pre-triage waiting subgroup.
data.quantity: Arrival-to-triage wait among patients who did not go directly to bed or triage
data.source_evidence_basis: Directly observed arrival time and routine triage time; subgroup distribution reported as median, IQR, and range.
data.limitations: Conditional on the 15.4% subgroup that did not proceed directly to a bed or triage; not a general door-to-provider estimate. Single-site workflow may differ substantially. external_proxy_candidate; qualitative confidence: moderate for its observed subgroup, low for transfer.

provenance.acquisition_method: limited factual paraphrase of primary paper inspected by research agent
